comments.body:
Deploy preview for *algolia-instantsearch* ready!

Built with commit 9adecc45edbc62c64a3b1427e25029e8498aced4

https://deploy-preview-2888--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com

Thanks @andymac4182. That's very cool indeed to be able to send URLs generated by the routing. However I think that with your change, we're loosing some information. The formatted parameters contains all the parameters exhaustively and the nbHits provides informations about the number of results computed by Algolia.

Can you maybe add your change as an alternative piece of information that people might want to use?

@bobylito Personally in the case of Google Analytics it doesn't make sense to send a URL that never existed and might not actually work. If there is extra parameters that aren't shown in the URL that aren't a default I would be surprised. 

I think doing a manual format of the URL should be for advanced users personally since I would imagine most people would be similar to myself and just want the correct page view stats which is based on the routing.
Well I think that's sound, thanks for the explanation @andymac4182

title: Use url that is pushed via routing for analytics
